artifacts.synopsis: Edgar Davis Johnson appealed Evangel Presbytery's judgment in a disciplinary case arising from his pursuit of divorce on a claim of spiritual desertion. The SJC did not sustain the appeal, approving the proposed decision by a 21-1 vote.
